raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Starting with batch 13, rows from collector 'v2' carry txn_ts values about 6 hours ahead of the 'legacy' convention (v2 12:xx vs legacy 06:xx for the same business period), which looks like UTC versus local (UTC-6) time. Converting v2 timestamps back to the legacy local convention before deriving txn_date should move the misdated late-evening transactions back to their correct days and clear the 00:00-06:00 and volume anomalies, but the offset is inferred from only a few samples.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.6, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS WITH t AS (SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CASE WHEN collector = 'v2' THEN CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) - INTERVAL 6 HOUR ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS txn_ts FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED') SELECT txn_id, customer_id, merchant_id, amount, txn_ts, CAST(txn_ts AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM t;"}}
